frontier.next_probe: register-alloc-pure-c A/B/C on the prologue addr comp (block-local var split, narrow int type, precompute); re-read text1b.i.greg birth order after each.

frontier.next_probe: Build clean single-function target.o (prelude.inc), run decomp-permuter from the floor-4 candidate with --stop-on-zero targeting the $v0/$v1 operand swap.

frontier.mechanism: Have the named GCC-pass mechanism (fold PLUS-operand canonicalization -> birth order). Missing only the documented exhaustion ledger + the mandatory /* FAKE */ annotation.
